items.stem: A fact table receives millions of new rows daily and reprocessing everything is too slow. Which loading pattern should you implement?

options.text: Incremental load of only changed/new data
options.rationale: Correct: incremental loading processes just the delta, avoiding full reloads.
Full loads reprocess all data and do not scale to daily millions of rows.
Not loading data does not solve the ingestion requirement.

options.text: Converting the table to a view only
options.rationale: A view does not address bulk ingestion performance.

Correct: notebooks transform batch data with PySpark or SQL.
Bastion is a secure remote-access service, unrelated to data transformation.
An NSG filters network traffic, not data.
